However, in this case, the attackers targeted that specific page. Meaning the machines involved in the attack all used the link to that page to connect to the server. If you check the sidebar on this page, you'll see Traffic stats. This means Voat has a way to track requests to pages. That's how the admins knew which the page was targeted.

Bottom line is: you can DDoS attack a website through a page. The page is just the 'entry point' to connect to the server. Which page is irrelevant, unless you want to send a message.
